profile.headline: Systems Software Developer at Reynolds and Reynolds
profile.summary:
I am a Wright State Graduate with a Bachelors degree in Computer Science, three years of experience in corporate IT environments, and the leadership traits necessary to increase any team's productivity.

I am always seeking ways to program to an interface rather than an implementation. I believe that if you invest more time in the planning phase of a project, the better the end result will be for not only that project, but the ones to follow. 

In my free time, I have been working on developing a Wrestling Tournament Management application. It takes a lot of experienced people to make large wrestling tournaments run efficiently, so I would like to streamline the redundant processes and make the job easier. The application, in its current form, supports the ability to insert new teams and wrestlers into the tournament via text file, seed wrestlers based on win-loss ratios, generate brackets based off of wrestler seeding, input match results via command line, and save/load tournament progress.

positions.title: Systems Software Developer
positions.description:
- Earned two meritorious performance awards
- Submitted several software and company-related suggestions
- Acted as the liaison between application developers and the company IT department.
- Frequently communicated with members of different departments.
- Identified issues in our development ecosystem that were the most difficult to troubleshoot. Added safeguards to protect against further occurrences and installed logging in tactical locations to aid future troubleshooting efforts.
Stack: Windows, Windows Server, Linux (Fedora), C#, C++, C, Perl, Bash, Powershell, PICK Basic

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
- Installed and maintained access control systems across the company’s headquarters; Provided initial specs for installations at remote sites.
- Performed hardware, software installation and troubleshooting on the company’s network, printers, computers, and user accounts
- Identified processes that were being completed in an inconsistent nature along with recurring problems; Created several pieces of documentation to help produce consistent and speedy outcomes.

positions.title: Trainer
positions.description:
- Served as leader of the store’s safety team
- Served as member of the cultural council
- Trained new clerks
- Performed nearly all jobs within the store
- Competed in the division’s bagging competition.
